title: Claude on Foundry — adoption, spend & gateway (v2)
description: Anthropic-analytics-style view of Claude on Foundry: adoption (DAU/WAU/MAU, leaderboards), spend (month to date, budget, token types incl. 1-hour cache writes), Claude Code productivity (accept rate, lines, skills, tools) and gateway + client reliability. Sources: APIM llm-emit-token-metric, APIM resource logs, Claude Code OTel metrics and events. Part of the claude-on-foundry plugin.

panels.title: Overview — the numbers Anthropic's analytics lead with
Estimated spend
panels.description: Gateway tokens × the price_table variable × the price multiplier, at list prices. 1-hour cache writes are priced at 2× input where the gateway reports them. Your Foundry invoice is authoritative.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
let gw = customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
    or (name == "azure.ai_gateway.client.token.usage"
        and tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.token.type"]) == "cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName),
         subject = tostring(customDimensions.Subject), quota = tolong(customDimensions.quota)
| extend t = case(name == "Prompt Tokens", "input", name == "Completion Tokens", "output",
                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", "cache read", name == "Cache Creation Tokens", "cache write 5m",
                  "cache write 1h")
| extend parts = iff(t == "cache write 1h", dynamic(["cache write 1h", "cache write 5m"]), pack_array(t))
| mv-expand type = parts to typeof(string)
| extend tokens = iff(t == "cache write 1h" and type == "cache write 5m", -valueSum, valueSum)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = tokens / 1e6 * F * case(type == "input", todouble(p[0]), type == "output", todouble(p[1]),
                                       type == "cache read", todouble(p[2]), type == "cache write 5m", todouble(p[3]),
                                       todouble(p[4]))
| extend api = tostring(customDimensions["API ID"]), env = tostring(customDimensions.Environment)
| project timestamp, model, user, subject, quota, api, env, type, tokens, cost, valueCount, priced = isnotnull(p);
gw
| summarize cost = sum(cost) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: This month (UTC)
panels.description: Ignores the dashboard time range. Projection is a straight-line run rate. Set the monthly_budget variable to see budget use, amber from 80%, red from 100% — the equivalent of a Console spend limit, as a warning only.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
let gw = customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
    or (name == "azure.ai_gateway.client.token.usage"
        and tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.token.type"]) == "cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens")
| where timestamp >= startofmonth(now())
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName),
         subject = tostring(customDimensions.Subject), quota = tolong(customDimensions.quota)
| extend t = case(name == "Prompt Tokens", "input", name == "Completion Tokens", "output",
                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", "cache read", name == "Cache Creation Tokens", "cache write 5m",
                  "cache write 1h")
| extend parts = iff(t == "cache write 1h", dynamic(["cache write 1h", "cache write 5m"]), pack_array(t))
| mv-expand type = parts to typeof(string)
| extend tokens = iff(t == "cache write 1h" and type == "cache write 5m", -valueSum, valueSum)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = tokens / 1e6 * F * case(type == "input", todouble(p[0]), type == "output", todouble(p[1]),
                                       type == "cache read", todouble(p[2]), type == "cache write 5m", todouble(p[3]),
                                       todouble(p[4]))
| extend api = tostring(customDimensions["API ID"]), env = tostring(customDimensions.Environment)
| project timestamp, model, user, subject, quota, api, env, type, tokens, cost, valueCount, priced = isnotnull(p);
let mtd = toscalar(gw | summarize sum(cost));
let elapsed = (now() - startofmonth(now())) / 1d;
let days = datetime_diff('day', endofmonth(now()), startofmonth(now())) + 1;
let B = todouble('${monthly_budget}');
print ['Month to date'] = mtd,
      ['Projected month-end'] = iff(elapsed > 0, mtd / elapsed * days, real(null)),
      ['% of monthly budget'] = iff(B > 0, mtd / B, real(null))

panels.title: Adoption rate
panels.description: Monthly active users ÷ the seats variable (licensed or entitled users, e.g. members of the quota-tier Entra groups). Shows '—' until seats is set.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let S = todouble('${seats}');
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(30d)
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})

| project rate = iff(S > 0, todouble(m) / S, real(null))

panels.title: Suggestion accept rate
panels.description: Accepted ÷ all Edit, Write and NotebookEdit proposals in Claude Code — Anthropic's headline productivity metric. Edits allowed by a permission rule count as accepted.

panels.title: Active users — daily, 7-day and 30-day
panels.description: Rolling distinct Entra users per UTC day, any client. Equivalent to the Enterprise Analytics DAU / WAU / MAU.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let from_ = startofday($__timeFrom());
let to_ = $__timeTo();
let active = customMetrics
| where timestamp between ((from_ - 29d) .. to_)
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize by subject = tostring(customDimensions.Subject), day = startofday(timestamp);
range timestamp from from_ to startofday(to_) step 1d
| extend k = 1
| join kind=leftouter (active | extend k = 1) on k
| summarize DAU = dcountif(subject, day == timestamp),
            WAU = dcountif(subject, day between ((timestamp - 6d) .. timestamp)),
            MAU = dcountif(subject, day between ((timestamp - 29d) .. timestamp)) by timestamp
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Claude Code sessions and prompts per day
panels.description: Sessions = distinct session.id with activity that day (Anthropic's 'sessions'). Prompts = user_prompt events. Source: Claude Code OTel events in Log Analytics (OTelLogs).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelLogs
| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body in ("claude_code.user_prompt", "claude_code.api_request")
| summarize Sessions = dcount(tostring(Attributes["session.id"])),
            Prompts = countif(Body == "claude_code.user_prompt") by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Leaderboard — Entra users, all clients (team insights)
panels.description: The Console 'team insights' table, keyed on the Entra user the quota uses. Click a user to filter the dashboard. Export with Inspect → Data → Download CSV. Gateway tokens × the price_table variable × the price multiplier, at list prices. 1-hour cache writes are priced at 2× input where the gateway reports them. Your Foundry invoice is authoritative.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
let gw = customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
    or (name == "azure.ai_gateway.client.token.usage"
        and tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.token.type"]) == "cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName),
         subject = tostring(customDimensions.Subject), quota = tolong(customDimensions.quota)
| extend t = case(name == "Prompt Tokens", "input", name == "Completion Tokens", "output",
                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", "cache read", name == "Cache Creation Tokens", "cache write 5m",
                  "cache write 1h")
| extend parts = iff(t == "cache write 1h", dynamic(["cache write 1h", "cache write 5m"]), pack_array(t))
| mv-expand type = parts to typeof(string)
| extend tokens = iff(t == "cache write 1h" and type == "cache write 5m", -valueSum, valueSum)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = tokens / 1e6 * F * case(type == "input", todouble(p[0]), type == "output", todouble(p[1]),
                                       type == "cache read", todouble(p[2]), type == "cache write 5m", todouble(p[3]),
                                       todouble(p[4]))
| extend api = tostring(customDimensions["API ID"]), env = tostring(customDimensions.Environment)
| project timestamp, model, user, subject, quota, api, env, type, tokens, cost, valueCount, priced = isnotnull(p);
let total = toscalar(gw | summarize sum(cost));
let topModel = gw | summarize mc = sum(cost) by subject, model | summarize arg_max(mc, model) by subject
| project subject, ['Top model'] = model;
gw
| summarize Spend = sum(cost), Billable = sum(tokens),
            Requests = sumif(valueCount, type == "output"),
            ['Active days'] = dcountif(startofday(timestamp), type == "output"),
            cached = sumif(tokens, type == "cache read"), inputs = sumif(tokens, type != "output"),
            ['Daily quota'] = max(quota), ['Last seen'] = max(timestamp)
    by User = user, subject
| join kind=leftouter topModel on subject
| extend ['Share of spend'] = iff(total > 0, Spend / total, real(null)),
         ['Spend per active day'] = iff(['Active days'] > 0, Spend / ['Active days'], real(null)),
         ['Cache hit ratio'] = iff(inputs > 0, cached / inputs, real(null))
| project User, Spend, ['Share of spend'], ['Spend per active day'], Billable, Requests, ['Active days'],
          ['Top model'], ['Cache hit ratio'], ['Daily quota'], ['Last seen']
| order by Spend desc

panels.title: Leaderboard — Claude Code users (client telemetry)
panels.description: Through the gateway Claude Code only knows a hashed user.id. Set OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=enduser.id=<upn> per user (e.g. an Intune script writing user-level settings) to show names here. Spend is Claude Code's own list-price estimate.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelLogs
| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body in ("claude_code.api_request", "claude_code.user_prompt", "claude_code.tool_decision")
| extend a = Attributes
| extend User = coalesce(tostring(a["enduser.id"]), tostring(ResourceAttributes["enduser.id"]),
                         tostring(a["user.email"]), tostring(a["user.id"]))
| extend isEdit = Body == "claude_code.tool_decision" and tostring(a.tool_name) in ("Edit", "Write", "NotebookEdit", "MultiEdit")
| summarize Spend = sumif(todouble(a.cost_usd), Body == "claude_code.api_request"),
            Sessions = dcount(tostring(a["session.id"])),
            Prompts = countif(Body == "claude_code.user_prompt"),
            ['Active days'] = dcount(startofday(TimeGenerated)),
            accepted = countif(isEdit and tostring(a.decision) == "accept"), edits = countif(isEdit),
            Terminals = make_set(tostring(a["terminal.type"]), 4),
            Version = max(tostring(a["app.version"])),
            ['Last active'] = max(TimeGenerated)
    by User
| extend ['Accept rate'] = iff(edits > 0, todouble(accepted) / edits, real(null)),
         Terminals = strcat_array(Terminals, ", ")
| project User, Spend, Sessions, Prompts, ['Active days'], ['Accept rate'], Terminals, Version, ['Last active']
| order by Spend desc

panels.title: Claude Code spend by ${breakdown}
panels.description: Pick the dimension with the 'Breakdown' variable: terminal / IDE, Claude Code version, effort, query source, model or speed — the splits in Anthropic's Claude Code Analytics API and Enterprise cost reports.

azureLogAnalytics.query:

| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body == "claude_code.api_request"
| summarize Spend = sum(todouble(Attributes.cost_usd)) by Value = coalesce(tostring(Attributes["${breakdown}"]), "(none)")
| order by Spend desc
| take 15

panels.title: Usage by API and model — price coverage
panels.description: A model shown as 'missing' is priced at zero everywhere on this dashboard. Gateway tokens × the price_table variable × the price multiplier, at list prices. 1-hour cache writes are priced at 2× input where the gateway reports them. Your Foundry invoice is authoritative.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let P = parse_json('${price_table:raw}');
let F = todouble('${price_factor}');
let gw = customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens")
    or (name == "azure.ai_gateway.client.token.usage"
        and tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.token.type"]) == "cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens")
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName),
         subject = tostring(customDimensions.Subject), quota = tolong(customDimensions.quota)
| extend t = case(name == "Prompt Tokens", "input", name == "Completion Tokens", "output",
                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", "cache read", name == "Cache Creation Tokens", "cache write 5m",
                  "cache write 1h")
| extend parts = iff(t == "cache write 1h", dynamic(["cache write 1h", "cache write 5m"]), pack_array(t))
| mv-expand type = parts to typeof(string)
| extend tokens = iff(t == "cache write 1h" and type == "cache write 5m", -valueSum, valueSum)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = tokens / 1e6 * F * case(type == "input", todouble(p[0]), type == "output", todouble(p[1]),
                                       type == "cache read", todouble(p[2]), type == "cache write 5m", todouble(p[3]),
                                       todouble(p[4]))
| extend api = tostring(customDimensions["API ID"]), env = tostring(customDimensions.Environment)
| project timestamp, model, user, subject, quota, api, env, type, tokens, cost, valueCount, priced = isnotnull(p);
gw
| summarize ['Est. cost'] = sum(cost), Billable = sum(tokens),
            Input = sumif(tokens, type == "input"), Output = sumif(tokens, type == "output"),
            ['Cache read'] = sumif(tokens, type == "cache read"),
            ['Cache write'] = sumif(tokens, type startswith "cache write"),
            Requests = sumif(valueCount, type == "output"), Users = dcount(subject), priced = countif(priced)
    by ['API ID'] = api, Model = model, Environment = env
| extend Price = iff(priced > 0, "found", "missing — add to price_table")
| project ['API ID'], Model, Environment, ['Est. cost'], Billable, Input, Output, ['Cache read'], ['Cache write'],
          Requests, Users, Price
| order by Billable desc

panels.title: Skills, plugins, MCP servers and subagents
panels.description: The Enterprise Analytics skills / plugins / connectors reports, from Claude Code events. Custom and third-party names are redacted unless OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelLogs
| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body in ("claude_code.skill_activated", "claude_code.subagent_completed", "claude_code.plugin_loaded",
                 "claude_code.tool_result", "claude_code.mcp_server_connection")
| extend a = Attributes
| extend params = parse_json(tostring(a.tool_parameters))
| extend Kind = case(Body == "claude_code.skill_activated", "Skill",
                     Body == "claude_code.subagent_completed", "Subagent",
                     Body == "claude_code.plugin_loaded", "Plugin (loaded)",
                     Body == "claude_code.mcp_server_connection", "MCP server (connect)",
                     tostring(a.tool_name) startswith "mcp", "MCP tool call", "")
| where isnotempty(Kind)
| extend Name = case(Kind == "Skill", tostring(a["skill.name"]),
                     Kind == "Subagent", tostring(a.agent_type),
                     Kind == "Plugin (loaded)", tostring(a["plugin.name"]),
                     Kind == "MCP server (connect)", tostring(a.server_name),
                     coalesce(tostring(params.mcp_server_name), tostring(a.tool_name)))
| summarize Uses = count(), Users = dcount(tostring(a["user.id"])), Sessions = dcount(tostring(a["session.id"])),
            ['Last used'] = max(TimeGenerated) by Kind, Name
| order by Uses desc

panels.title: Tool reliability
panels.description: Success and duration per tool from tool_result events. Red below 90% success.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelLogs
| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body == "claude_code.tool_result"
| extend a = Attributes
| extend Tool = tostring(a.tool_name), ok = tostring(a.success) == "true", ms = todouble(a.duration_ms),
         err = substring(tostring(a.error), 0, 80)
| summarize Calls = count(), ['Success rate'] = avg(iff(ok, 1.0, 0.0)),
            ['p50 duration'] = percentile(ms, 50), ['p95 duration'] = percentile(ms, 95),
            Users = dcount(tostring(a["user.id"])), ['Top error'] = take_anyif(err, not(ok) and isnotempty(err))
    by Tool
| order by Calls desc

panels.title: p95 time to first token

| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body == "claude_code.api_request"
| summarize p95 = percentile(todouble(Attributes.ttft_ms), 95)

panels.title: 404s on Claude paths
panels.description: No API: matched no API — usually a wrong base URL or a :443 suffix (amber from 1). Unsupported operation: the API exists but not the operation, e.g. count_tokens or /v1/models, which Claude Code tolerates.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ResponseCode == 404
| where Url contains "/v1/messages" or Url contains "/v1/models" or Url contains "/otlp"
| summarize ['No API (wrong URL)'] = countif(isempty(ApiId)),
            ['Unsupported operation'] = countif(isnotempty(ApiId))

panels.title: Telemetry ingestion success
panels.description: OTLP API that forwards Claude Code telemetry to Azure Monitor. Amber below 99%, red below 95%.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url matches regex @"/otlp/v1/(traces|metrics|logs)"
| summarize ok = countif(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)), n = count()
| project rate = iff(n == 0, real(null), todouble(ok) / n)

ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url matches regex @"/v1/messages(\?|$)"
| extend status = case(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299), "2xx",
                       BackendResponseCode == 429, "429 Foundry",
                       ResponseCode in (401, 403, 429) and isnull(BackendResponseCode), strcat(ResponseCode, " gateway"),
                       ResponseCode == 0, "connection dropped",
                       strcat(ResponseCode))
| summarize requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), status
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Latency — gateway vs client
panels.description: Gateway: time to last byte (whole stream). Client: time to first token as measured by Claude Code.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where isnotempty(ApiId) and Url matches regex @"/v1/messages(\?|$)"
| where ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)
| summarize ['gateway p50 total'] = percentile(TotalTime, 50), ['gateway p95 total'] = percentile(TotalTime, 95)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

OTelLogs
| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body == "claude_code.api_request"
| summarize ['client p50 TTFT'] = percentile(todouble(Attributes.ttft_ms), 50),
            ['client p95 TTFT'] = percentile(todouble(Attributes.ttft_ms), 95)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Client-side API errors and refusals
panels.description: What users saw, after Claude Code's retries. Refusals come from the model's safety classifiers; Foundry has no server-side fallback, so watch this after a model upgrade.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelLogs
| where ServiceName matches regex "^(${client:regex})$"
| where Body in ("claude_code.api_error", "claude_code.api_refusal")
| extend a = Attributes
| summarize Count = count(), ['Max attempt'] = max(toint(a.attempt)), Users = dcount(tostring(a["user.id"])),
            ['Last seen'] = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Kind = iff(Body == "claude_code.api_refusal", "refusal", "error"), Status = tostring(a.status_code),
       Model = tostring(a.model), Detail = substring(coalesce(tostring(a.category), tostring(a.error)), 0, 120)
| order by Count desc

ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where Url contains "/v1/messages" or Url contains "/v1/models" or Url contains "/otlp"
| where not(ResponseCode between (200 .. 399))
| extend Path = replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(Url).Path), @"^/[^/]+", "")
| summarize Count = count(), ['Last seen'] = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Path, Status = ResponseCode, ['Backend status'] = BackendResponseCode,
       Source = LastErrorSource, Reason = LastErrorReason, Message = substring(LastErrorMessage, 0, 160)
| order by Count desc

panels.title: Requests by API and APIM subscription
panels.description: API = first path segment of the gateway URL.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where Url contains "/v1/messages" or Url contains "/otlp"
| extend Api = tostring(split(parse_url(Url).Path, "/")[1])
| summarize Requests = count(),
            ['2xx'] = countif(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299)),
            ['Gateway 4xx'] = countif(ResponseCode between (400 .. 499) and isnull(BackendResponseCode)),
            ['Foundry 429'] = countif(BackendResponseCode == 429),
            ['5xx / dropped'] = countif(ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0),
            ['Last seen'] = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Api, ['APIM subscription'] = iff(isempty(ApimSubscriptionId), "(Entra ID / none)", ApimSubscriptionId)
| order by Requests desc

| where timestamp >= startofday(now())
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), user = tostring(customDimensions.UserName),
         subject = tostring(customDimensions.Subject), quota = tolong(customDimensions.quota)
| extend t = case(name == "Prompt Tokens", "input", name == "Completion Tokens", "output",
                  name == "Prompt Cached Tokens", "cache read", name == "Cache Creation Tokens", "cache write 5m",
                  "cache write 1h")
| extend parts = iff(t == "cache write 1h", dynamic(["cache write 1h", "cache write 5m"]), pack_array(t))
| mv-expand type = parts to typeof(string)
| extend tokens = iff(t == "cache write 1h" and type == "cache write 5m", -valueSum, valueSum)
| extend p = P[extract(@"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|mythos)-\d+(?:-\d\b)?", 0, model)]
| extend cost = tokens / 1e6 * F * case(type == "input", todouble(p[0]), type == "output", todouble(p[1]),
                                       type == "cache read", todouble(p[2]), type == "cache write 5m", todouble(p[3]),
                                       todouble(p[4]))
| extend api = tostring(customDimensions["API ID"]), env = tostring(customDimensions.Environment)
| project timestamp, model, user, subject, quota, api, env, type, tokens, cost, valueCount, priced = isnotnull(p);
customMetrics
| where timestamp >= startofday(now())
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where '__all__' in (${user:singlequote}) or tostring(customDimensions.UserName) in (${user:singlequote})
| summarize Used = sum(valueSum), Quota = max(tolong(customDimensions.quota)),
            User = take_any(tostring(customDimensions.UserName)) by Subject = tostring(customDimensions.Subject)
| join kind=leftouter (gw | summarize ['Cost today'] = sum(cost) by Subject = subject) on Subject
| extend ['% of quota'] = iff(Quota > 0, todouble(Used) / Quota, real(null))
| project User, Used, Quota, ['% of quota'], ['Cost today']
| order by ['% of quota'] desc
